push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.1. You played like someone who read the playbook twice and highlighted it.

+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 17%). You timed it like a grandfather clock.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). Making chances is a gift, and you were Santa Claus tonight.
+ A brace against Inter Aliens, your first since Oct 1. You put it where Grandma keeps the good cookies: right on the top shelf.

Muscle memory: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked.

tuxedo_slide, from me to you: Win the next five seconds, then the next five.

Keep the good times rolling. - Coach Lasso
